summary: the largest value of a sampled series and the independent variable at which it is first reached

inputs.name: series
inputs.meaning: the samples as a list of pairs, each the independent variable in its own unit (a run's time at each step, a spectrum's wavelength at each channel) and the value there in the quantity's unit

outputs.name: found
outputs.meaning: true when the series has a largest value; false, with why, when it is empty or a sample is not a pair

outputs.name: maximum
outputs.meaning: the largest value, in the quantity's unit

outputs.name: at
outputs.meaning: the independent variable at the first sample holding the largest value, in the independent variable's own unit, which no manifest of a series of any kind can name; the reader says it from the series it handed

outputs.name: index
outputs.meaning: that sample's place in the series, counted from zero

outputs.name: why
outputs.meaning: when found is false, why nothing was found

validity: a series as sampled: the largest sample, not the largest value between samples, since nothing here interpolates, so the maximum and its place are as fine as the sampling; where two samples hold the largest value the first is taken. It judges nothing: whether the maximum is near a reference is a tolerance a person chooses

source.citation: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods, section 1.3.5.6, Measures of Scale (read 2026-11-18, https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/eda/section3/eda356.htm; meta_agent/inbox/materials/20261118-nist-sematech-measures-of-scale)
source.locus: the entry range: the largest value minus the smallest value in a data set; the largest value of a data set is the one this skill gives

note: Taken from what round two of the CFD test's clone built and used (series_maximum@v2 of run cfd/20261117-21, collect-1; its bundle session ran it in run cfd/20261117-14), written here as the first version of this library, its source read again by this seat; cfd-9 asked that the unit of the place of the maximum follow the series, which a manifest cannot name, so its meaning says whose it is to name. A benchmark that reports a largest coefficient and the instant it occurs, such as the DFG 2D-3 flow around a cylinder, is what it was made for, and a spectrum's peak is the second kind its cases show. No value of the source stands behind the worked cases: each is worked by hand in its worked field. v2 is v1 made common, unchanged in its code and its cases' values: every simulation bundle carries it (the person, 2026-11-18, docs/ideas/20261118.md; meta_agent/tasks/025), and each worked case names the kind of system it is worked on, at least two unrelated kinds. A build adapts it to an engine as a next version that names the engine and says adapted_from. v3 says that maximum takes the unit of the series' values and at the unit of its independent variable (unit_of, unit_of_part), so that the builder follows the input to the unit of what was handed and gives a tolerance on it that unit, where it gave '1' (meta_agent/failures.jsonl rheotool-27; the manifest field, 7a4b9fc). The code and the worked cases are the previous version's, unchanged. Common, as before.
